# Fsp group 400 w atx power supply 12v 80 plus certified vital series (vital 400)

The FSP Group Vital 400 is a 400-watt ATX power supply certified 80 Plus for high efficiency, designed for stability and compatibility with multi-core Intel and AMD CPUs. It features a quiet 120mm fan, dual +12V rails, and energy saver mode, with a 3-year warranty and compliance with various safety standards. Its specifications include multiple output connectors and complete protection mechanisms, ensuring reliable performance and support for modern systems.
